dog.description_text: Meet Greyson — New Arrival! Greyson just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDMhh1zUNxqT4bgNd_VHjoZAdm6qv_tjz1rolTluAuItmM?e=F4nGUR Greyson is a handsome 2 1/2 year old male. He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. He is a social guy who enjoys the company of other cats. He likes to play and is very affectionate. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
